title: Obtainability audit: what is never obtained, in any era
note: Step `--pass obtain` (lib/obtain.mjs). Starts from every world source the pack has today in any era and every recipe of any tier, and lists the items and fluids of the audited namespaces that are never obtained, grouped by material and classified A (give it a source), B (arrives with a later era from docs/journey.md: hide until then) or C (will never arrive: hide it with its recipes). Inherits from steam the recipe types with no machine, the aliases, the tools, the boilers and the steam machines.

world.note: GTM's rubber trees in the Overworld and the sticky resin they drop.
GTM 7.5.3 GTPlacedFeatures/GTBiomeModifiers: marble and red granite patches in the Overworld.
The Moon's ground (gcyr:luna, by hand at the end of HV since v0.5.0): the lunar drill's regolith sample needs regolith and lunar sand (data/grindless/tables/veins_moon.json).
Mars' ground (gcyr:mars, by hand with the tier 2 rocket at the end of EV since v0.6.0); the tripod's stone on Mars.
GTM's charcoal pile igniter burns logs in the world and leaves brittle charcoal: it isn't a recipe.
The facade cover comes from a special recipe (gtceu:crafting_facade_cover) that the analysis doesn't read.

later.label: the End's pitchblende vein, held back until IV (veins_excluded.json)
later.note: Its plutonium ore also gives uraninite, and the radioactive chain (uranium, radon, quantum eye and star, and what needs them) is IV's radioactives. Since IV-A1 GTM's naquadah vein is gone from the End: naquadah comes from Venus (grindless:naquadah_vein_venus, the venus-mercury stage).

classes.reason: molten cerrobase 140: only the GT-- circuit assembly line (LuV) asks for it, which integration/gtnn.js keeps, and nothing melts it (the dust does mix); its melting recipe arrives with LuV (decision of 2026-10-24)
ore forms of iridium and osmium: docs/journey.md gets them from Mercury's crust in IV

classes.era: IV (heavy water from the Martian ice)
classes.reason: deuterium: since EV it has no source (hydrogen_separation is removed and both ender air recipes lose it, offworld_only.json); IV makes heavy water from Mars' deuterium-rich ice. Only tritium separation and fusion (LuV) use it
helium and nitrogen plasma: only GTM's fusion makes them, from deuterium (D + T, Be + D), which has no source until IV's heavy water; fusion is LuV

GTCA's zinc plasma: only GTM's fusion reactor makes it (gtceu:fusion_reactor/zinc_plasma, copper + tritium, 49,152 EU/t), and tritium only comes from IV's removal facility since IV-A1's cuts; fusion is LuV

classes.era: ZPM (GTCA's comet, from fusion's helium plasma)
classes.reason: GTCA's helium ion: the comet (122,880 EU/t) makes it from helium plasma, which needs fusion and deuterium
Dyson swarm from docs/journey.md (UHV): GCYR gives no recipe for these parts
GCYR satellites, beam receiver and station parts: docs/journey.md opens orbit in LuV; they have no recipe today
space elevator and its modules: docs/journey.md places it in ZPM; today GTCA gives no recipe for the modules (integration/gtca.js)
casings for the UEV–MAX tiers from docs/journey.md: GTM gives them no recipe
GCYM-style parallel machine from Extended Features: no recipe until the IV wave wants it (integration/extendedfeatures.js)
GT-- circuit assembly line (LuV): only missing molten cerrobase 140, which arrives with LuV
GT-- naquadah line: comes from processing naquadria ore, which no vein gives today; it will arrive with the naquadah veins (docs/journey.md: Venus, IV)
plutonium fuel for the GT-- naquadah reactor: needs neutronium mixture, which comes from a neutronium ore that no vein gives (docs/journey.md: neutronium in UIV)
hidden in EMI: only exists for old saves and converts into the new thing (empty vein probe); its conversion recipe stays

GTCA's samarium-terbium branch: since EV samarium is Martian, and flsamaric_to_ho no longer gives the samarium-terbium mixture (offworld_only.json), so the branch has no input anywhere; its terbium and gadolinium have no other consumer
GTCA: removed by the pack (integration/gtca.js): machines that cheapen a line or pull energy out of nothing, and whatever only they made or burned
GTCA: water purification plant with no controller recipe (integration/gtca.js), and the alloy only its casing asks for
addon material with ore blocks in every stone type but no vein in any dimension: nothing gives it
Extended Features: controller removed by the pack (integration/extendedfeatures.js)
GT--: no recipe on purpose (integration/gtnn.js)
leftovers from GTM's naquadah separation, which GT-- empties out (enableHarderNaquadahLine): nothing produces them
technical block (dimension marker), not for the player
solar panel: GTM 7.5.3 only gives a recipe to the ULV and LV ones (the LV one arrives with naquadah)
passthrough hatch: GTM 7.5.3 only gives a recipe to the HV one
bedrock ore miner: GTM 7.5.3 gives it no recipe (there are no bedrock ores)
construction foam blocks: GTM 7.5.3 has no sprayer, nothing places them
joke item, technical item, or one with no recipe in GTM 7.5.3 / its addon
Damascus steel: GTM tool material that no recipe makes
material with no source whose recipes only give things that already come another way (calcium, potassium, sulfur, iron, chromium...)

IV-A1's shared ids whose producer is a later IV package (fuel fabrication, hot cell, heavy-water plant, tritium removal, Mercury, travel; docs/eras/iv.md); tritium has no other source since IV-A1's cuts. Each rule stops matching when its producer lands; C1 removes the stale ones
tuff dust: only comes from milling ore blocks in tuff (the drill gives raw ores), and has no use of its own
GCYR Martian rock dust: only the stone byproduct of milling Martian ore blocks (the tripod gives raw ores, and nothing mills the rock itself), with no use of its own
UDMH: rocket engine fuel with no recipe; GT-- engines burn hydrazine and RP-1, which are made
hydrogen plasma: GCYR accepts it as fuel, but nothing produces it
GTCA: part or material with no recipe or vein that the pack doesn't use
GT--: end-game circuits and parts whose chain starts from something with no recipe
GCYR: part or material with no recipe that the pack doesn't use
Extended Features: part with no recipe (the addon doesn't bring one)
the material comes from chemistry, but has no vein: its ore forms (raw, crushed, washed, impure...) never come out
loose forms of a material that is otherwise obtainable: nothing makes them (molten forms, plasmas, dusts of something that's fluid-only)
